statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit of home, category, video detail, signup, and error templates.

page.framework: Server-rendered multi-page application with deferred client hydration
page.notes: Public localized adult-video catalog. The first load presents legal age-verification messaging and a consent dialog.

checkOutcomes.evidence: color-scheme computed as normal under a matched dark preference; theme is not preference-driven.
Eight two-second shimmer animations remained running.

checkOutcomes.method: prefers-contrast emulation plus axe contrast audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: prefers-contrast matched while axe found 48 contrast failures.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS/API feature inspection across route-heavy MPA
checkOutcomes.evidence: No view-transition CSS was present for listing, detail, and signup navigation.
No scroll-linked animation or scrollytelling surface was observed on the representative templates; there is no scroll animation implementation to classify.
checkOutcomes.reason: No scroll-linked animation or scrollytelling surface was observed on the representative templates; there is no scroll animation implementation to classify.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM and visual inspection of primary interactions
checkOutcomes.evidence: Primary surfaces use ordinary anchors, buttons, native page scrolling, and a standard media region; no custom gesture interaction that fights platform behavior was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Computed-position probe of header and navigation
checkOutcomes.evidence: Header and navigation are position: sticky with explicit top offsets, so chrome responds to scroll position without a custom fixed overlay.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS feature inspection and header-menu recon
checkOutcomes.evidence: Header dropdowns are present but no CSS anchor positioning declarations were found.
No directional transition, marker, or highlight mechanism was detected for the route-heavy navigation.
A centered cookie dialog obscures core content on home, category, video, and error templates.
Signup uses DIV role=dialog rather than the native dialog primitive.
Two banners, two header rows, a sidebar, and the consent overlay leave little unobstructed catalog space.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout metrics at 360x800 on three templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: All three templates measured 1024 px scroll width against 360 px visual viewport width, with 664 px overflow.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS feature inspection and narrow screenshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: No container queries were detected and desktop sidebar/grid geometry persists at 360 px.

checkOutcomes.method: Programmatic focus, target measurement, and Lighthouse
checkOutcomes.evidence: Focused link computed no outline; many 16 px controls were measured and Lighthouse failed target-size.
The home H1 identifies popular videos, category labels are explicit, and the detail page puts its title and player region first.

checkOutcomes.method: Repeated signup CTA interaction with DOM and screenshot comparison
checkOutcomes.evidence: The email signup CTA did not advance or add account inputs in two attempts.
The real 404 state clearly says the page was not found and provides a return-to-home action while retaining useful navigation.
Lighthouse LCP was 4.5 s and FCP 2.8 s; trace corroborated long load work.
CLS was 0 in Lighthouse and the mobile layout observer recorded no shifts.
Two long tasks were recorded, longest 168.71 ms, with 135.17 ms TBT.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against live script/style attributes
checkOutcomes.evidence: 150 requests transferred 1.78 MB; 66 were scripts and three parser-inserted stylesheets were critical, while script candidates were confirmed deferred.
Lighthouse estimated 56 KiB unused CSS and 26 KiB unused JavaScript.
axe found an unnamed button, prohibited ARIA, nested interactivity, and aria-hidden focusable content.
axe reported 48 home contrast failures and six signup failures.

checkOutcomes.method: axe structural rules and focus style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Landmark uniqueness/containment failed and the first focusable link had no computed outline.

checkOutcomes.method: Desktop screenshots across content and account templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Primary headings and body text are readable at the audited desktop size without clipping; contrast exceptions are recorded separately.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse viewport/target audits plus narrow layout
checkOutcomes.evidence: user-scalable=no, failed target sizing, and 664 px narrow overflow prevent accessible zoom/reflow.
Lighthouse errors-in-console audit scored 1 with no recorded items.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM document probe and image audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype/UTF-8 pass, but 29 images lack dimensions and 12 are oversized.
Three deprecated API warnings were emitted by the challenge script.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered DOM and raw-HTML discoverability comparison
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home and video detail have descriptive unique titles and descriptions, all present in raw HTML.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw/rendered comparison, link DOM, and mobile layout
checkOutcomes.evidence: Content is 89% raw-HTML visible and uses href links, but the page forces 1024 px into 360 px and disables user scaling.

checkOutcomes.method: Canonical/hreflang DOM probe plus robots and sitemap fetch
checkOutcomes.evidence: Canonical is present, but no hreflang appears for localized hosts and /sitemap.xml returns 404 without a robots declaration.
Video detail has Open Graph metadata but no VideoObject or other JSON-LD.
HTTPS/HSTS pass, but CSP is frame-ancestors only, nosniff/referrer policy are missing, and two cookies lack Secure.
121 third-party requests transferred 1.65 MB across 16 origins before consent interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse permission audits and signup-method inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permissions prompt on load, but visible auth choices are Google, X, and email with no passkey option.
HSTS/frame protection pass, but CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy coverage are incomplete.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw server HTML versus rendered DOM and crawler screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw HTML retains 89% of home and 78% of video content, including title, H1, and description; neither page is a JS shell.

checkOutcomes.method: Repeated signup interaction and state inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The email account step did not render and provided no timeout, retry, or error fallback.
Manifest has name, start_url, minimal-ui display and three icons; active service worker source contains cache, fetch-handler, and offline signals.
A 404 route renders a clear explanation, support reference, home recovery link, and useful content rather than a blank shell.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM language and localized-site navigation inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited document declares pt-BR and the language menu exposes localized hosts including RTL languages; no translation clipping was visible on the Portuguese templates.
Portuguese labels and Brazilian decimal punctuation are used consistently on counts and localized content across the sampled pages.
No dates, scheduled events, recurring intervals, or time-zone-sensitive values were exposed on the representative catalog, detail, signup, or error templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: No dates, scheduled events, recurring intervals, or time-zone-sensitive values were exposed on the representative catalog, detail, signup, or error templates.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Consent presents Accept and Reject at equal prominence, and signup explicitly states how public personal data will be used; no confirmshaming or forced continuity was observed.

No editable registration form rendered and the only available input was optional search, so there was no required-field validation state to exercise; the broken signup transition is recorded under flow and resilience checks.
checkOutcomes.reason: No editable registration form rendered and the only available input was optional search, so there was no required-field validation state to exercise; the broken signup transition is recorded under flow and resilience checks.

checkOutcomes.method: Signup-step DOM inspection after CTA activation
checkOutcomes.evidence: No account fields rendered and the only input remained search with autocomplete=off.
The email signup route remained on the initial dialog after activation and offered no recovery.
12 images were oversized, 29 lacked dimensions, eight below-fold images were eager, and 16 were classified as legacy format.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR and trace review during idle initial load
checkOutcomes.evidence: Only six XHR/fetch requests were observed and no autoplay media element loaded before age verification; wasteful media playback was not observed.
Third parties contributed 1.65 MB and 121 requests before media interaction.
No developer intent or agent-facing workflow was declared or visible. This emerging capability is not applicable to the sampled consumer media experience.
checkOutcomes.reason: No developer intent or agent-facing workflow was declared or visible. This emerging capability is not applicable to the sampled consumer media experience.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No developer intent or user-facing inference task was visible; absence of built-in AI is not penalized for this consumer media surface.
checkOutcomes.reason: No developer intent or user-facing inference task was visible; absence of built-in AI is not penalized for this consumer media surface.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline and post-interaction heap summaries after ten full-page scroll cycles
checkOutcomes.evidence: Post snapshot decreased by 522,828 self-size bytes and 5,200 nodes relative to baseline, showing no retained-growth signal in the exercised cycle.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap-summary totals proportional to a media catalog
checkOutcomes.evidence: Baseline was 38.4 MB self size across 719,691 nodes and post-interaction was slightly lower; the footprint remained bounded during the sampled session.
Summaries showed no Detached constructor population and total nodes decreased after repeated interaction; no accumulation signal was observed.

principleOutcomes.reason: No developer intent or agent-facing workflow was declared or visible. This emerging capability is not applicable to the sampled consumer media experience. No developer intent or user-facing inference task was visible; absence of built-in AI is not penalized for this consumer media surface.

paths.description: Homepage and popular-video listing: entry template, navigation, consent, preferences, mobile reflow, performance, network, accessibility, security, and memory.
Amateur category listing: representative filtered/listing archetype and mobile layout.
Video detail: representative core content/player surface, metadata, crawlability, consent, and age-verification entry.
Signup/account journey: representative modal account flow, disclosure, accessibility, and CTA progression.
Synthetic unknown URL: representative HTTP 404 and recovery state.

findings.summary: Theme is hard-coded instead of declaring platform color-scheme support.
findings.evidence: Under emulated dark preference the surface is usable, but computed color-scheme remains normal and the same dark palette is imposed rather than being preference-driven.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light and dark tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Loading shimmer continues under reduced-motion.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe found eight running shimmer-56cf2 animations, each with a 2000 ms duration, while prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matched.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential shimmer and auto-motion in a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce media query.

findings.summary: Controls and text do not remain reliably legible at increased contrast needs.
findings.evidence: The preference probe confirmed prefers-contrast: more, while axe still reported 48 color-contrast failures on the home template.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce high-contrast tokens, test forced-colors, and ensure essential text and controls meet WCAG contrast.

findings.summary: Navigation changes are abrupt.
findings.evidence: Feature inspection found no view-transition CSS on this multi-page site, despite route-heavy navigation across listings, details, and signup.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive cross-document view transitions for major template changes and preserve reduced-motion fallbacks.

findings.summary: Dropdown navigation does not use anchored positioning.
findings.evidence: CSS feature inspection found no anchor-name or position-anchor use while the header exposes multiple dropdown menus.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS anchor positioning with position-try fallbacks for header dropdowns and edge-aware transient UI.

findings.summary: Navigation does not visibly guide attention after movement.
findings.evidence: No view-transition or scroll-marker/highlight support was detected, and the route-heavy interface relies on abrupt full-page changes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use directional transitions and explicit focus/highlight cues after route and in-page navigation.

findings.summary: A first-load cookie dialog obscures the primary content.
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots on the home, category, video, and 404 templates show a large centered consent overlay covering the main task.
findings.suggestedFix: Move essential consent controls to a less obstructive, immediately dismissible surface while keeping Accept and Reject equally prominent.

findings.summary: Modal experiences use custom div dialogs.
findings.evidence: Signup DOM inspection found a DIV with role=dialog rather than a native dialog; the cookie overlay likewise appears as custom UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog for modal flows, with native focus management and close behavior, and popover for transient non-modal UI.

findings.summary: Promotional chrome crowds the first viewport.
findings.evidence: The desktop home first view contains two full-width promotional/verification banners, two navigation rows, a persistent sidebar, and a modal over the content grid.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse secondary promotions, reserve the first viewport for the core catalog, and make verification messaging compact after acknowledgement.

findings.summary: Desktop layout is forced into a 360 px viewport.
findings.evidence: Layout captures on home, category, and video report scrollWidth 1024 against visualViewportWidth 360, producing 664 px horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed 1024 px layout constraints, honor the device viewport, and use intrinsic fluid grids that reflow at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Reusable components do not adapt at container level.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no container queries, while the sidebar and card grid retain desktop geometry in the narrow capture.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container-type to reusable regions and use size-aware container queries for cards, sidebars, and controls.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch-target sizing are inadequate.
findings.evidence: Programmatic focus on the first visible link computed outline none; Lighthouse also failed target-size and the probe found many 16x16 and 20 px-high links.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a visible :focus-visible treatment and expand targets or spacing to at least platform accessibility guidance.

findings.summary: The signup CTA does not advance to the email step.
findings.evidence: Two CDP interaction attempts clicked Cadastre-se com e-mail after load and after rejecting cookies; the dialog, input set, and screenshot remained unchanged with only the search input present.
findings.suggestedFix: Wire the CTA to a reliable declarative action, expose a loading/error state, and verify the complete registration path with a real browser flow.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP misses the good Core Web Vitals range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.5 s and FCP 2.8 s on the home page; the performance score was 0.79.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP element, reduce critical dependencies, and defer non-essential promotion and consent code.

findings.summary: Load scripting creates long main-thread tasks.
findings.evidence: The trace recorded two long tasks, the longest 168.71 ms, with 135.17 ms total blocking time; the mobile layout observer saw a 183 ms task.
findings.suggestedFix: Break up long initialization tasks, defer non-critical work, and schedule by priority.

findings.summary: Initial delivery is request-heavy.
findings.evidence: The HAR records 150 requests and 1.78 MB transferred, including 66 scripts and three high-priority parser-inserted stylesheets; DOM confirmation shows scripts are deferred but styles remain critical.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce critical stylesheet count, consolidate dependency chains, and load secondary feature bundles only on demand.

findings.summary: The mobile page ships avoidable unused code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 56 KiB unused CSS and 26 KiB unused JavaScript on the initial page.
findings.suggestedFix: Split template-specific CSS and load optional feature JavaScript only when the corresponding surface is used.

findings.summary: Interactive semantics are invalid or unnamed.
findings.evidence: axe found a critical unnamed button, a nested interactive control, prohibited ARIA, and focusable content inside aria-hidden on the home page.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control an accessible name, remove nested interactivity, and align ARIA with native element roles.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails widely.
findings.evidence: axe reported 48 color-contrast nodes on home and six on signup; Lighthouse failed its color-contrast audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground and surface tokens to meet WCAG AA in every card, navigation, consent, and footer state.

findings.summary: Landmarks and focus behavior are not robust.
findings.evidence: axe found non-unique landmarks, complementary landmarks nested below top level, uncontained regions, and aria-hidden focusable content; focus inspection showed no visible outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct landmark hierarchy and uniqueness, remove hidden focus targets, and maintain a clear visible focus order.

findings.summary: Zoom, reflow, and targets fail the mobile accessibility baseline.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports user-scalable=no, failed target sizing, and the 360 px evidence shows 664 px overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user scaling, reflow at 320 to 400 CSS px, and enlarge or separate small controls.

findings.summary: Image sizing and asset structure are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 29 of 36 images without dimensions, 12 oversized images, and 16 legacy-format results, despite a valid doctype and UTF-8 charset.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio, serve right-sized responsive sources, and prefer modern formats consistently.

findings.summary: Deprecated browser APIs are still exercised.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found three deprecation warnings in the Cloudflare challenge script, including Shared Storage, persistent StorageType, and Protected Audience API use.
findings.suggestedFix: Update or configure the third-party challenge dependency to stop invoking deprecated APIs.

findings.summary: The public pages are not mobile-friendly despite crawlable HTML.
findings.evidence: Links and metadata are server-rendered, but the 360 px layout forces a 1024 px page and Lighthouse flags disabled user scaling.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep real href links, but replace the desktop-width layout and permit scaling so indexed pages are genuinely mobile-friendly.

findings.summary: Localized indexing signals are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Canonical URLs are present, but no hreflang links were found despite dozens of language/locale subdomains, and /sitemap.xml returned HTTP 404 with no sitemap declaration in robots.txt.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish reciprocal hreflang links and a sitemap index, then declare it in robots.txt.

findings.summary: The video detail lacks structured entity data.
findings.evidence: The detail page has useful Open Graph tags but zero JSON-LD blocks for the visible video entity.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD that matches the title, thumbnail, duration, upload data, and canonical URL.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but CSP and cookie protections are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers show CSP limited to frame-ancestors, missing nosniff and Referrer-Policy; cookie audit found settings and x_csrf_token without Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy an allowlist CSP, add nosniff and a restrictive Referrer-Policy, and mark all HTTPS cookies Secure with appropriate SameSite and HttpOnly.

findings.summary: The initial page has a broad third-party data surface.
findings.evidence: HAR records 121 third-party requests and 1.65 MB transferred across 16 third-party origins, including collector.xhamster.com and an ad origin, before consent interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate optional analytics and advertising until consent, minimize identifiers, and batch or remove non-essential collection.

findings.summary: Authentication offers federated and email choices but no phishing-resistant option.
findings.evidence: No notification or geolocation prompt occurs on load, but the signup dialog exposes Google, X, and email only; no passkey/WebAuthn path is visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and sign-in alongside existing methods and request browser permissions only after a user action.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defenses are too narrow.
findings.evidence: HSTS and clickjacking controls are present, but CSP only sets frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and nosniff are absent, and Permissions-Policy only configures client hints.
findings.suggestedFix: Expand CSP, add nosniff and Referrer-Policy, and explicitly deny unnecessary powerful features in Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The signup runtime does not recover when its next step fails to appear.
findings.evidence: After the email CTA was activated, the dialog remained unchanged with no loading, error, or fallback state.
findings.suggestedFix: Load the email step conditionally with timeout/error handling and provide a retry or direct fallback link.

findings.summary: Signup input assistance is unavailable because the email step never renders.
findings.evidence: After activating the email signup CTA, the only input in the document remained the site search with autocomplete=off; no sign-up field or autocomplete token appeared.
findings.suggestedFix: Render labelled email/account fields reliably and use correct email, username, and new-password autocomplete tokens.

findings.summary: The account-creation flow is not completable in the audited state.
findings.evidence: The signup dialog clearly explains public-data use, but its email path did not progress in repeated CDP interactions and showed no recovery message.
findings.suggestedFix: Repair and monitor the account flow end to end, preserve the clear disclosure, and add an actionable failure state.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes and misses intrinsic sizing.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 12 oversized images, 29 without dimensions, eight below-fold images not lazy-loaded, and 16 legacy-format results.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive AVIF/WebP sources sized to display needs, lazy-load below-fold media, and reserve dimensions.

findings.summary: Third-party cost dominates the initial page.
findings.evidence: Third-party requests account for 1.65 MB of the 1.78 MB initial transfer and 121 of 150 requests before the user starts media.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay optional third parties and media until consent or interaction, and set a template-specific third-party budget.

taskList.title: Rebuild responsive reflow and zoom behavior
Repair and instrument the signup journey
Fix accessible names, landmarks, focus, contrast, and targets
Harden CSP, headers, cookies, and third-party consent gating
Reduce initial consent and promotional obstruction
Improve LCP and split critical/unused assets
Optimize responsive images and third-party media cost
Honor system motion, contrast, and theme preferences
Complete localized search and rich video metadata
